# nautobot_vlan (Resource)

This object manages a VLAN in Nautobot



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) VLAN name.
- `status` (String) Status of the VLAN (name).
- `vid` (Number)

### Optional

- `description` (String) Description of the VLAN.
- `role_id` (String) Role UUID associated with the VLAN.
- `tags_ids` (List of String) Tags associated with the VLAN.
- `tenant_id` (String) Tenant UUID associated with the VLAN.
- `vlan_group_id` (String) VLAN group UUID.

### Read-Only

- `created` (String) Creation timestamp (RFC3339).
- `id` (String) VLAN UUID.
- `natural_slug` (String) Natural slug for the VLAN.
- `notes_url` (String) Notes URL for the VLAN.
- `prefix_count` (Number) Number of prefixes associated with this VLAN.
- `url` (String) API URL of the VLAN.
